name: Neighborly Graces
text:
Your ability to talk with the world around you is more than just sympathetic feeling; you can have full conversations among the flowers, rocks, and birds. While you're often expected to serve as a mediator between the river and the waterfall, you might take that role seriously, or you might shirk it. You can cast Speak with Animals as an occult innate spell at will.

In addition, once per day, you can cast Speak with Plants, Speak with Stones, or Speak With Water as an occult innate spell. You choose which spell you cast each time you use this ability.
